requirements.quote: `admit(clusters, {governor, state, openProdIssues, now})` returns `{file:[], summary:null|{title, body}}`.
It enforces `max_issues_per_hour`, `max_open_prod_issues` and `max_cost_usd_per_round` (as in signal-planner Phase 0).
On overflow it files ONE summary issue that lists the deferred clusters, instead of a storm.
Document how these keys map to signal-planner's `max_issues_per_run`/`max_cost_usd`.

Rules: pure functions with an injected `io` (exec/gh/llm/now) like bin/lean/issuewatch.mjs; read-only by contract; deterministic first; core stays repo-agnostic (#1347). Repo is PUBLIC: no raw customer data in fixtures.

deliverables.change: New pure module exporting admit(clusters,{governor,state,openProdIssues,now}) -> {file,summary}. Only fileable, non-duplicate, non-expected-class clusters are candidates; order incident, then defect, then rest (severity P0..P3, count desc, fingerprint tiebreak). Budget = min(max_issues_per_hour minus state.filed timestamps within 1h of now, max_open_prod_issues minus openProdIssues.length, floor(max_cost_usd_per_round / cost per cluster)); cost per cluster = cluster.cost_usd ?? governor.cost_per_issue_usd ?? 0 (0 means no cost cap). Missing/invalid limit = unlimited for that key. Overflow -> one summary {title, body} listing deferred clusters (class, severity, count, first/last seen, reason deferred); no SIGNAL_REF in summary so deferred clusters stay re-admittable. No fs, no gh, no Date.now (use now).

node:test cases: each of the three caps, hourly window expiry, incidents before defects, one summary only (not per cluster), no summary when nothing overflows, non-fileable/duplicate skipped, determinism, input not mutated; a 70-memo storm via fixtures/prodwatch through cluster+classify yields bounded file list plus one summary.

Add prodwatch-governor entry after the prodwatch-triage entry, with the key mapping: max_issues_per_hour is a rolling-hour rate (signal-planner max_issues_per_run is per run); max_open_prod_issues is a standing cap with no planner equivalent; max_cost_usd_per_round maps to the planner's max_cost_usd applied per poll round; a run's effective issue cap = min of the three.
